title: Balancing energy, expectations and perfectionism with Ambika Singh, Founder and CEO Armoire
summary: Kahran's older sister Ambika Singh — founder and CEO of clothing-rental company Armoire — talks about the tension between her personal brand and her company brand, what values-based customers actually look like at six months, and how being an extreme extrovert shapes her energy. Late in the conversation she gets into being a mother of two young boys, knowing she isn't a good full-time parent, and the why-questions she circled before turning 40.
topics: founder personal brand vs company brand
energy and extroversion as a founder
being a working mother of young kids

intents.display: to hear a founder-ceo talk through perfectionism, energy and never feeling prepared
to hear a founder admit she's not a good full-time parent
